lines: Operational overview -- request volume, latency, errors, tool usage, quality, and cost.

**Modelled cost, not billed cost.** MLflow reports input tokens as the uncached-equivalent total, so its token counters look the same whether or not prompt caching worked.
Billed units apply the published multipliers: cache read 0.1x, rolling (5m) write 1.25x, static (1h) write 2x, uncached 1.0x. Output tokens are never discountable. The DBU panel is the real-money cross-check.
_Prefix rebuilds per 100 requests_ is a health signal: a static write should happen about once per hour per replica. If it tracks request count, the cached prefix has stopped being byte-stable.
